2608.10843.title: Hypothesis Frontier: Verifier Guided LLM and Symbolic Search for First-Order Induction
2608.10843.paper_summary: First-order concept synthesis asks a system to infer one formula that classifies labeled objects consistently across several finite relational structures. Every candidate can be evaluated exactly, but quantified first-order formulas form a vast search space, and LLM outputs are often semantically promising without being fully correct. We introduce Hypothesis Frontier, a verifier-guided neurosymbolic framework that evaluates each LLM formula on every training object, retains the strongest verified hypothesis across rounds, and uses its remaining errors to guide subsequent generation. Symbolic processing repairs invalid formulas while remaining anchored to the LLM-generated hypothesis, and simplifies train-valid formulas without changing any training prediction. Under matched models, problem sets, and LLM-round budgets, Hypothesis Frontier solves substantially more problems than repeated original-prompt generation. After the final formulas are selected, exact simplification shortens many train-valid formulas while preserving every training prediction. Exact symbolic reasoning therefore helps both to solve more induction problems and to compress many of the resulting formulas.
2608.10843.paper_summary_zh: 第一階概念綜合要求系統推斷出一個公式，該公式能在幾個有限的關係結構中一致地對標記物體進行分類。每個候選者都可以被精確評估，但量化的一階公式形成了一個龐大的搜索空間，而大型語言模型的輸出通常在語義上是有前景的，但並不完全正確。我們引入了假設邊界（Hypothesis Frontier），這是一個由驗證器引導的神經符號框架，該框架在每個訓練物體上評估每個大型語言模型公式，保留每輪中最強的驗證假設，並利用其剩餘的錯誤來指導後續生成。符號處理修復無效的公式，同時保持與大型語言模型生成的假設相連接，並在不改變任何訓練預測的情況下簡化訓練-驗證公式。在匹配的模型、問題集和大型語言模型回合預算下，假設邊界解決的問題數量遠超過重複的原始提示生成。在最終公式選定後，精確簡化縮短了許多訓練-驗證公式，同時保留了每個訓練預測。因此，精確的符號推理有助於解決更多的歸納問題，並壓縮許多結果公式。
2608.10843.author: Serafim Batzoglou et.al.
